summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with an updated docstring and Note; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed; math import removed; PatchIter added to __all__), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset), and a new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with test_shape, test_loading_array, and test_missing_len. Judgment calls: setUp seeds with 1234 and test_loading_array also seeds once at its start; both test images are np.arange(16) reshaped to (1, 4, 4), which I checked against the pinned values. Unverified: pytest was not run, the docstring example output was derived by reasoning, and the rtol=1e-5 checks against 4-decimal pinned values may fail on rounding. Line-length check found only pre-existing over-120 lines in get_valid_patch_size, which were left untouched.
